description.zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the instance that you want to query.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[创建资源组](~~94485~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see [Create a resource group](~~94485~~).

title.zh: 查询已配置网站业务转发规则的域名

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domains --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
